ThumbnailWatch.description: Snapshot of a thumbnail topic; the events carry everything.

status.description: Whether a thumbnail can be shown now.

version.description: For `ready`: changes whenever the file changes; pass it as `v` so a new version is loaded.

items.description: Each with `ready` and its version, or `none`.

size.description: The two thumbnail sizes: rows of the list, tiles of the grid (both twice their CSS size for sharp screens).

ThumbnailsReady.description: Event of `thumbnails/<share>/<folder>`: thumbnails that were rendered or refused.

timeZone.description: IANA name of the system time zone.

synchronized.description: Whether the clock is synchronized with a time server.

ntpServers.description: Time servers Pithyx configured; empty means the distribution's defaults.

timeZones.description: Every time zone the system knows.

timeZone.description: IANA name of the new time zone.

ntpServers.description: At most eight host names or addresses; empty for the distribution's defaults.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

recoveryCode.description: One of the recovery codes shown when TOTP was enabled, instead of a code.

id.description: Id for restoring or deleting it.

name.description: Its name when it was deleted.

originalPath.description: Where it was, relative to the share; restoring puts it back there.

kind.description: File, folder, symlink or another kind.

size.description: Bytes, for a folder everything inside it.

deletedBy.description: User name of who deleted it, if that user still exists.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted for good, or null when the share keeps deleted items until emptied.

TrashItem.description: One item in a share's recycle bin.

ids.description: Items of the share's recycle bin, at most 1000.

oneOf.description: For restoring: what happens when the original place is taken; rename when left out.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

retentionDays.description: Days the share keeps deleted items; 0 keeps them until the bin is emptied.
0 to 3650; 0 keeps deleted items until the bin is emptied.

reason.description:
Why it stays unmounted: `system_path` (`/` or at or below a system directory), `shadows_mount` (it
would hide something mounted there or below), `duplicate_mountpoint` (another dataset of the pool mounts there
first) or `key_unavailable` (encrypted and locked).

enabled.description: False hides the app from everybody and stops serving its frontend; its data and grants stay.
Switches the catalog on or off; null leaves it.

registryToken.description: user:token to pull the catalog's private images; empty removes it, null leaves it.

grants.description: The user's own grants; the editor changes these.

inherited.description: What its groups give it; changed on the group.

effective.description: What the user may do: the union of both, or everything for an administrator.

UserGrants.description: The rights of a user for the editor. Administrators only.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has the administrator right, its own or through a group.

totpEnabled.description: Whether the user signs in with a second factor.

permissions.description: What the user may do; the topic `session/permissions` sends changes.

groups.description: The user's groups by name, without the built-in group every user is in; apps get them in their context.

username.description: The Linux user name, lower case.

displayName.description: Shown instead of the user name, if set.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has the administrator right, its own or through a group; administrators have every right.

uid.description: The Linux uid from the Pithyx range (20000 to 29999), never reused.

totpEnabled.description: Whether the user signs in with a second factor.

createdAt.description: When the user was created, UTC.

home.description: The user's home folder on a pool, or null when there is no pool yet.

disabled.description: Deactivated: cannot sign in, and the Linux account is expired.

rights.description: The special rights the user has (`right:admin`, `right:desktopLogin`, `right:sshLogin`, `right:power`), its own and through its groups; a deactivated user gets them back when activated.

protocols.description: The file protocols the user may use (`protocol:smb`, `protocol:sftp`, `protocol:webdav`, `protocol:ftp`), the same way.

fileServicePassword.description: Whether SMB and SFTP know the user's password. They learn it when the user signs in on the web or an administrator sets it; until then the user cannot use them.

groupIds.description: The groups the user is a member of; the built-in group `users`, which has everybody, is left out.

UserSummary.description: A user as the Users page shows it. Administrators only.

displayName.description: An empty text removes the display name.

disabled.description: Deactivates or activates the user; deactivating ends the user's sessions. Nobody deactivates themselves or the last active administrator.

groupIds.description: Every group the user should be a member of, besides the built-in group `users`; the user leaves the others.

UserUpdate.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

name.description: Vdev name as ZFS shows it: `raidz1-0`, `mirror-1` or the device's by-id name.

vdevGuid.description: Vdev GUID as decimal text; names a device in commands even when it is missing.

type.description: ZFS vdev type: `disk`, `file`, `mirror`, `raidz`, `draid`, `spare`, `replacing` and so on.

role.description: What the vdev is for: `data`, `log`, `cache`, `special`, `dedup` or `spare`.

path.description: Device path of a leaf vdev, usually below `/dev/disk/by-id`.

parityDisks.description: Parity level of a raidz vdev (1 to 3), otherwise null.

readErrors.description: Read errors since import or the last clear.

writeErrors.description: Write errors since import or the last clear.

checksumErrors.description: Checksum errors since import or the last clear.

missing.description: True for a leaf whose disk is not connected, also while ZFS has not noticed yet (see PoolHealth).

serial.description: Serial of the disk a leaf is on, as last seen connected, if known.

parent.description: The network card or bond that carries the VLAN's tagged frames.

appId.description: The app the preference belongs to.

width.description: Last free width of the app's windows in CSS pixels.

height.description: Last free height in CSS pixels.
